source: NSQF 2023 gazette notification, entry requirements for short-term training (docs/references/NSQF-Gazette-Notification-June2023.pdf), as extracted in docs/Utsav/research/01-the-customer.md §7
note: Each level lists alternatives; meeting any one is enough. 'class' = minimum years of schooling, 'literate' = can read and write, 'exp' = years of relevant experience. Levels above 4 are out of scope for this beneficiary group and are never recommended.
